futuresGrid.checkLiquidationDown: Est. lower liquidation price {price} ({distance} from current)
futuresGrid.checkLiquidationUp: Est. upper liquidation price {price} ({distance} from current)
futuresGrid.checkNote: Official Pionex estimate; no order is placed. The actual liquidation price moves with fills and funding.
futuresGrid.extraMarginHelper: Not traded by the grid; only pushes the liquidation price further away

lossStopHelper.long: Stops and closes when the price falls to this; by amount, when the loss reaches it
lossStopHelper.no_trend: Lower stop loss: stops and closes when the price falls to this; by amount, when the loss reaches it
lossStopHelper.short: Stops and closes when the price rises to this; by amount, when the loss reaches it

futuresGrid.lossStopHighHelper: Stops the neutral grid and closes when the price rises to this

profitStopHelper.long: Stops and closes when the price rises to this; by amount, when the profit reaches it
profitStopHelper.no_trend: Neutral grids can only take profit by amount
profitStopHelper.short: Stops and closes when the price falls to this; by amount, when the profit reaches it

grid.aiStrategyApplied: Applied the Pionex AI suggestion: {annualized} annualized, {drawdown} max drawdown

form.investmentHelper: The bot can only use this amount
form.liveFuturesGridNote: A live futures grid creates a Pionex futures grid bot with its own position and margin, visible and manageable in the Pionex app. Your futures account needs enough USDT.
form.liveGridNote: A live grid creates a Pionex grid bot, which you can also view and manage in the Pionex app.
form.maxDailyLossHelper: The bot stops when the day's loss reaches this amount
form.name: Name
form.paperFeeRateHelper: Charged on simulated fills. See <link>Pionex fees</link>

signal.hint: Starting the bot creates a dedicated Pionex custom signal and copy bot. TradingView alerts go straight to Pionex, not through this system, so server downtime doesn't affect it.
signal.leverageMax: Up to {max}x for this symbol; Pionex recommends at most 10x for signal bots
signal.stopLossHelper: Pionex closes when the loss reaches this share of the investment
signal.takeProfitHelper: Pionex closes when the profit reaches this share of the investment

webhook.orderAmount: Buy amount when the signal has none

reasons.order_canceled_externally: An order was canceled outside the bot (e.g. in Pionex)

signal.description: Create an alert in TradingView and use the webhook URL and message below. The message template comes from Pionex; keep its field names unchanged.
signal.positionSizeHelper: Position after the signal: positive is long, negative is short, 0 is flat, same as the TradingView strategy position_size
signal.secret: The webhook URL contains a Pionex token; anyone with it can trade for this bot. Keep it private.

send.confirm: Send "{action}, size {contracts}, target position {positionSize}"? Pionex will place real orders from this signal.

send.title: Send signal

typeDescriptions.dca: Averages down in steps, takes profit, then starts the next cycle.
typeDescriptions.grid: Buys low and sells high within a range, suited to sideways markets. Live grids run on Pionex.
typeDescriptions.indicator: Buys and sells on technical indicator conditions.
typeDescriptions.webhook: Trades on external signals such as TradingView alerts.
typeDescriptions.futures_grid: Leveraged long, short or neutral grid within a price range. Live bots run on Pionex futures grid.
typeDescriptions.signal: Pionex opens and closes positions from your TradingView strategy signals, with its own position and Pionex-run take profit / stop loss. Live only.

webhook.actionsHint: Actions: buy, sell, close. Add amount to sell to sell only part.

regenerate.confirm: The old token stops working immediately; update your TradingView alerts too.

regenerate.title: Regenerate token

webhook.title: Webhook settings
webhook.tokenOnce: The token is shown only once. Copy it now; you can regenerate it if lost.

closePosition.confirm: Close the <bold>{pair}</bold> {direction} position of {size} at market price?
closePosition.label: Market close
closePosition.title: Market close

futures.leverageRiskLimit: Limited to {max}x by your futures risk settings
futures.leverageWarning: Higher leverage moves the liquidation price closer to the current price. Changes apply to new orders and the margin of current positions.

marginModeDescriptions.CROSS: Cross: all cross positions share the futures account's available margin.
marginModeDescriptions.ISOLATED: Isolated: this symbol's position only uses its own margin, which caps the loss.

positionModeDescriptions.BUYSELL: One-way: each symbol has a single net position; buys and sells offset each other.
positionModeDescriptions.OPENCLOSE: Hedge: hold long and short positions on the same symbol at once, opening and closing separately.

futures.positionModeWarning: Position mode applies to the whole Pionex futures account, including trading in the app. The exchange may refuse to switch while you have positions or open orders.

market.label: Market
market.notFound: This trading pair was not found. It may have been delisted.
